rule_plain_words: PRIMARY "5-FU-treated" group. Arm 5FU, FUFOL or FOLFOX in the GEO record, AND stage II or III. Patients whose chemotherapy type is not given (66), "other" (3) or unknown (17) are left out because we cannot tell which drug they got. FOLFIRI is left out (irinotecan; see its own row). Stage 0, I, IV and missing stage are left out.
Subset: arm 5FU only (5-FU without leucovorin or oxaliplatin), stage II-III.
Subset: arm FUFOL (5-FU + leucovorin), stage II-III.
Subset: 5FU or FUFOL (5-FU without oxaliplatin), stage II-III.
Subset: arm FOLFOX (5-FU + leucovorin + oxaliplatin), stage II-III. Also the GSE39582 group of the oxaliplatin units.
Optional subset, never part of the primary group: FOLFIRI (5-FU + leucovorin + irinotecan), stage II-III. Too small to test (3 patients).
Comparator: "no chemotherapy", stage II or III only (same stages as the treated group).
